card.name: Linking words in ACE inhibitor lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas (or, and, comma) right after an ACE inhibitor name such as benazepril, trandolapril or fosinopril. Also spaces before a dose number.

modes.label: Link after ACE inhibitor
modes.description: An 'or', 'and' or comma follows an ACE inhibitor name in a list or pairing.

modes.label: Space before a dose number
modes.description: The gap just before a mg dose figure in dosing ranges.
modes.example: The usual dose range is 25 to<< >>150 mg b.i.d.

card.plain: It fires on the small word or comma that comes right after an ACE inhibitor name, and sometimes just before a dose number.
